title: Pyramid of the Niches, El Tajín
summary: The Pyramid of the Niches is the best-known building of El Tajín, a pre-Hispanic city in Veracruz, Mexico. It has a square base 36 metres on a side, rises in stepped levels, and carries 365 niches. Arqueología Mexicana says it was built in a single phase, around AD 1100–1150.

uncertainty.note: Arqueología Mexicana: built in a single stage "hacia 1100-1150 d.C."; ICOMOS gives the city's occupation as 800 to 1200 and INAH gives its peak as 600 to 1000 CE, so the pyramid's date is not firmly fixed.
